meta.name: jaspar-motifs
meta.description: Guide for using JASPAR transcription factor binding profiles with ENCODE ChIP-seq data. Use when users need to find TF binding motifs in ENCODE peaks, validate ChIP-seq targets with known motifs, or scan regulatory regions for TF binding potential. Trigger on: JASPAR, motif database, binding profile, PWM, position weight matrix, TF motif, motif enrichment, motif scanning, binding site prediction.

copy.tagline: 在ENCODE峰中查找转录因子结合基序
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做转录因子结合位点分析或ChIP-seq数据验证
copy.tagline_en: Find transcription factor binding motifs in ENCODE peaks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if analyzing transcription factor binding sites or validating ChIP-seq data

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你用 JASPAR 数据库中的转录因子结合图谱（PWM）分析 ENCODE 的 ChIP-seq 数据，验证目标转录因子是否直接结合 DNA，发现共结合因子，并评估变异对结合位点的影响。
howto.when: 当你需要验证 ENCODE ChIP-seq 峰中的转录因子结合基序、扫描调控区域寻找潜在结合位点，或评估变异对基序的影响时触发。

say.text: 帮我验证 CTCF ChIP-seq 峰中是否富集 CTCF 基序。
扫描 K562 细胞中 GATA1 和 TAL1 共结合区域的基序间距。
say.note: Claude 会指导你使用 FIMO 扫描并分析间距。

say.text: 检查 rs7903146 变异是否破坏 FOXA2 基序。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude helps you use JASPAR transcription factor binding profiles (PWMs) to analyze ENCODE ChIP-seq data: validate direct DNA binding of target TFs, discover co-binding factors, and assess variant impact on motifs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to validate TF motifs in ENCODE ChIP-seq peaks, scan regulatory regions for binding potential, or assess variant effects on motifs.

say_en.text: Validate whether CTCF ChIP-seq peaks are enriched for the CTCF motif.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch the CTCF motif from JASPAR and guide enrichment analysis.

say_en.text: Scan co-occupied regions of GATA1 and TAL1 in K562 for motif spacing.
say_en.note: Claude will guide FIMO scanning and spacing analysis.

say_en.text: Check if rs7903146 disrupts the FOXA2 motif.
say_en.note: Claude provides motifbreakR or Python code to assess impact.
